name: Fugitive Finder
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 255
Aura moderate conjuration and transmutation CL 8th
Slot none; Price 12,655 gp; Weight 4 lbs.
Description
This +1 human-bane light crossbow has a gold-colored metal lath and a keyhole-shaped slot for the bolt to rest in. The wielder gains a +10-foot enhancement bonus to his base speed. The church of Abadar typically commissions fugitive finders to aid officials in chasing down and capturing escaped criminals, but Abadarans also craft variants that have the merciful special ability instead of human-bane, giving the wielder a better opportunity to capture a fleeing target alive.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, longstrider, summon monster I; Price 6,495 gp
